papers.name: Theory Fundamentals
papers.description: Assesses syllabus sections 1 to 8. Short and longer answers testing knowledge and understanding of the principles of computer science and their application to solving problems.

source.method: transcribed; quotes verified against the page

papers.verbatim: Theory Fundamentals 1 hour 30 minutes | Paper 1 will assess sections 1 to 8 of the | 50% of the AS Level

papers.name: Fundamental Problem-solving and Programming Skills
papers.description: Assesses syllabus sections 9 to 12. Tests programming knowledge and skills. Candidates are not required to write programming code; an insert of pseudocode built-in functions and operators is provided.

source.method: transcribed; quotes verified against the page

papers.verbatim: Fundamental Problem-solving and 2 hours | Paper 2 will assess sections 9 to 12 of the syllabus content
